name: Magical Stability (Item Mastery)
body:
Your magic items become harder to destroy.

Prerequisite(s): Magic item skill class feature.

Benefit(s): Select one magic item in your possession. That item gains 10 bonus hit points and its hardness is increased by 1 while you wear or carry it. You can replace your chosen item with another through a 24-hours attunement ritual.

Special: This feat can be selected multiple times. Each time, it applies to a different magic item.
